unusual_experiment.question: Does the exact public source structure already falsify a Jacobian-Lens adapter path for the owner-selected Qwen3.5-0.8B cognition substrate?
unusual_experiment.method: Compare Anthropic Jacobian-Lens HFLensModel layout/forward requirements against current upstream Qwen3.5 text-decoder structure and the selected checkpoint config. No model weights were loaded and no provider/runtime execution occurred.
unusual_experiment.counterhypothesis: Qwen3.5 hybrid linear/full attention or multimodal wrapping makes the reference Jacobian-Lens adapter structurally unusable before any runtime test.

observations: Jacobian-Lens auto-layout includes model.language_model and requires residual layers, final norm, embeddings and top-level lm_head.
Qwen3.5 uses a hybrid 3:1 linear-attention/full-attention text stack rather than a homogeneous softmax-attention stack.
Qwen3.5 text model preserves a residual block stack and normal text-decoder embedding/norm structure, so hybrid attention does not source-level falsify hook-based residual observation.
The selected public 0.8B checkpoint is configured as Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, so exact wrapper/layout behavior still requires executable verification.
Static structure cannot establish Jacobian backward stability, memory use, fit convergence, lens quality or a functional global workspace on Qwen3.5-0.8B.

delta.local_component_test: 8/8 PASS in isolated container before GitHub write

next_gate: Run exact bound Qwen3.5-0.8B + tokenizer through current Jacobian-Lens from_hf, minimal apply, jacobian_for_prompt and small fit on an authorized isolated runtime; record exact model/tokenizer/runtime/lens/corpus digests and preserve any failure.
